invariants.name: Tenant and verified-customer boundaries
invariants.oracle: No cross-tenant/customer resource or secret access, including errors, logs, jobs and files.

invariants.name: Secrets and egress stay outside model authority
invariants.oracle: Only approved server adapters resolve credentials and approved destinations receive allowed data.

invariants.name: Money, stock and authority are deterministic
invariants.oracle: Exact currency-aware paid/quantity limits, current policy and native evidence determine effects; never generated prose.

invariants.name: Approval is bound and revocable
invariants.oracle: Resource/configuration/amount changes or current revocation invalidate permission before execution.

invariants.name: Unknown effects reconcile before retries
invariants.oracle: Stable operation identity and source records prevent blindly repeating uncertain financial/physical effects.

invariants.name: Ownership is fenced at actions and messages
invariants.oracle: Late previous workers cannot mutate or speak for a case after ownership changes.

invariants.name: Skills tailor guidance, not permission
invariants.oracle: Profile text cannot override capabilities/security; one base skill works across declared merchant profiles.

invariants.name: No-AI path remains available
invariants.oracle: Every released deterministic operational action remains usable with models disabled; generated-only features have explicit limits.

invariants.name: Agent, model and platform portability
invariants.oracle: Qualified substitutions preserve business records/actions/policies; unsupported configurations fail closed, not silently downgrade.

invariants.name: Consent and privacy survive queued work and restore
invariants.oracle: Final send checks and storage-wide lifecycle controls prevent stale permission or restored deleted data.

invariants.name: Fulfillment is independent of payment and return status
invariants.oracle: Delivered is not inspected; invoiced is not paid; manifested is not accepted; foreign holds cannot be cleared.

invariants.name: Missing evidence cannot become a success claim
invariants.oracle: No app-test pass from a planning validator, no settlement from a record alone, no partnership/live pilot from a simulation.

invariants.name: Accepted features and tests cannot silently disappear
invariants.oracle: Trusted baseline flags missing/disabled/reidentified obligations and protected oracle changes; independent review governs rebaselining.

invariants.name: Safe restore, migration and case continuity
invariants.oracle: Restore/import start effect-disabled; one system owns writes; source facts and approved semantics remain recoverable.
